Nara has two stations.
Only one drops you at the deer. 🦌

Kintetsu-Nara sits at the edge of Nara Park.
JR Nara is a 15–20 minute walk further west.
Todaiji's Great Buddha? About 20 minutes on foot
from the Kintetsu side.

Kintetsu or JR: which one did you take? 👇
